description: This PHP source file defines the AccountsTester class within the Step\Acceptance namespace. It provides methods for creating account records directly in the database and via UI interactions, primarily for acceptance testing purposes in the SuiteCRM project. The class extends AcceptanceTester and utilizes various helper classes to simulate user actions and interact with the application UI.

classes.name: AccountsTester
classes.description: A testing class for automating acceptance tests related to account creation in SuiteCRM, extending the AcceptanceTester class with additional helper methods.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates an account record directly in the database with a specified name, returning the generated account ID.

methods.name: createAccountForElasticSearch
methods.description: Simulates UI interactions to create an account in the application, making it index-ready for Elasticsearch.

methods.name: getPublicScenario
methods.description: Returns the current testing scenario instance.
